Supreme Court Litigation Clinic 

Crown Quadrangle 
559 Nathan Abbott Way 
Stanford, CA 94305-8610 
Tel  650 724.1900 
Fax  650 723.4426 
sup.ct.clinic@law.stanford.edu 

July 9, 2018 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk of the Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:  Budha Ismail Jam, et al. v. International Finance Corporation,  

No. 17-1011 

Dear Mr. Harris, 

On July 2, 2018 the Court granted the parties’ joint motion to extend the merits 

briefing schedule in this case. Currently, petitioners’ brief is due on July 13, 2018 and 
respondent’s brief due August 29, 2018.  

After conferring with counsel for respondent, the parties hereby request one 

further – and final – request to extend the briefing schedule, making petitioners’ brief 
now due July 24, 2018 and respondent’s brief due September 10, 2018.  

This schedule represents mutually agreed upon extensions for both sides, which 
are necessary due to the heavy press of business for both lawyers. As with the previous 
extension request, the proposed briefing schedule will result in the completion of 
petitioners’ and respondent’s merits filings well in advance of the November argument 
sitting. 

Thank you very much for your consideration. 

Very truly yours, 

Jeffrey L. Fisher 
Counsel for Petitioners 

cc: 

Donald B. Verrilli, Munger Tolles & Olson LLP 
Francis Vasquez, Jr., White & Case LLP 

           Counsel for Respondent
